attributes.name: Pit Gladiator
attributes.powers:
Bury this card to add 2d6 to your combat check. If the result exceeds the difficulty by 10 or more, recharge this card instead

Discard this card to draw all the weapons from your discard pile, then explore your location.

corrections.corrected_text: On the ally Pit Gladiator, replace "If you defeat the bane by 10 or more, recharge this card instead" with "If the result exceeds the difficulty by 10 or more, recharge this card instead”.
corrections.issue: Pit Gladiator lets you recharge it if you use it to defeat a bane by 10 more. What if the bane has multiple checks?
